Crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk were shown the summaries for a given topic from the three systems in arbitrary order, along with a corresponding reference summary. They were asked to rank the systems with respect to Content (content overlap with the reference), Readability (the degree to which a summary is readable and well-understood), Grammaticality (avoiding grammar errors), and Non-Redundancy (avoiding information repetition).
